decisions.reason: The valve and flow-control change does not alter the leak-containment requirement; the separate leakage clause in the same message is already represented by its own MODIFY.
The valve and flow-control change does not alter the cleaning requirement; the separate removable-or-flushable spout clause is already represented by its own MODIFY.
The specified valve mechanism and controlled flow do not change the spout's bottom location, barista-facing orientation, or selected geometry.
Calling for a simple valve or tap does not change the existing V1 priority or off-the-shelf sourcing policy.
The dispensing mechanism and flow behavior do not affect the machine's green accent color.
The dispensing mechanism and flow behavior do not change the machine name or wording requirements.
The valve and controlled-stream specifications do not modify the DJ-turntable-inspired visual identity.
The dispensing-control change does not alter the bowl's capacity or deep-well form.
The source specifies dispensing flow rather than changing the independently defined splash-control target for mixing.
The valve and flow details inform the design work but do not change the CAD deliverable, its selected design direction, or its scope.
